about: Data banks for bigger life chapters (dungeon/life/chapters.py): courses someone goes back to school for, what they do with their days once retired, small businesses they start (dungeon/life/business.py) and long-term health conditions (dungeon/life/health_turns.py), by era: modern (today and the future), jazz-age (the 1920s) and other (any older past, such as Victorian London, a medieval kingdom or a fairy-tale land). Courses and businesses split the older past into medieval (a medieval kingdom or a fairy-tale land) and victorian (any other older past, such as Victorian London or the frontier). A condition marked light is more of a nuisance than a worry, and the news is told that way. Picked by seed; never shown as a list.
